assets.label: 房屋 Lv.1
assets.primaryRequest: a modest compact medieval civilian cottage, one low single-story pale fieldstone and dark oak house, one simple muted golden-brown shingle roof, one small integrated brick chimney, one closed wooden door and a few warm shallow windows, sober low-saturation settlement materials
assets.structureRequest: exactly one closed low single-story square 2x2 cottage body, exactly one continuous simple hipped roof and one small chimney integrated into the roof; no second floor, no tower, no dormer, no annex, no porch and no detached component; solid walls continue directly to the ground-contact line; absolutely no base slab, plinth, platform, foundation, terrain or props
assets.detailRequest: preserve the exact low single-story cottage silhouette, roof, chimney, camera and ground-contact edge; refine pale weathered fieldstone, restrained dark oak framing, muted golden-brown shingles, one closed plank door and two or three warm shallow windows; no second floor, tower, dormer, annex, porch, base slab, plinth, platform, terrain or loose props
